title: Ingress Anomaly Countdown
summary: Live countdowns to upcoming Ingress anomaly events, with faction signup links and results as they happen.
tagline: Anomaly dates, local times and live results in one place.
description: Follow upcoming Ingress anomaly sites with live countdowns, event-local times, faction signup links and results as they become available.

features.title: Your time and local time
features.description: Show each event in the viewer's time zone and the event's local time.

features.title: Live status
features.description: Advance cards automatically through preparation, imminent, live and faction-coloured result states.

features.title: Faction links and results
features.description: Link to Resistance and Enlightened signup sites where available, then link to published results.

features.title: Companion map
features.description: Plot upcoming sites and their L16 recharge ranges for remote participation planning.

features.title: Self-maintaining series
features.description: Remove an anomaly series automatically after all its events have passed.

origin.title: A reminder for people who need to plan.
origin.body: I built this because time zones can be challenging. Each anomaly shows its start time in both the viewer's time and the event's local time, with links to the Resistance and Enlightened team sites. The days in the countdown help people intending to travel plan ahead, while the hours are useful for those watching the score. A few weeks later I added a map of each upcoming site's L16 recharge range for people intending to participate remotely.
